categories.main_business_segments: CIFI Holdings (Group) Co. Ltd. primarily operates in three main segments: property development, property investment, and property management services. The property development segment involves the development and sales of residential, office, and commercial properties mainly in China. The property investment segment focuses on leasing investment properties to generate rental income and capital appreciation. The property management segment provides property management and related services across the Group's portfolio.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group integrates green building practices, digital innovation, and smart community concepts into its property development. It emphasizes low-carbon, high-tech, and intelligent construction methods throughout the product design, construction, administration, and operation phases. The Group also applies fair value measurement models for investment properties and uses advanced valuation techniques such as income capitalization and discounted cash flow methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CIFI serves end-users and investors in the real estate market, focusing on residential buyers, commercial tenants, and office space users. Its primary markets are first- and second-tier cities in China, including major urban clusters like the Yangtze River Delta, Pan Bohai Rim, Central Western Region, and South China Region. The Group also targets core urban clusters with demand driven by urbanization and industrial upgrading.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates predominantly in the People's Republic of China, with a nationwide presence covering first-, second-, and third-tier cities. Key regions include the Yangtze River Delta, Pan Bohai Rim, Central Western Region, and South China Region. Major cities with projects include Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Chengdu, Wuhan, Tianjin, and others. The Group also has overseas projects but the majority of operations and assets are in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: CIFI operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain. It is engaged in land acquisition, property development, sales, leasing, and property management. The Group also holds investment properties for rental income and capital appreciation, positioning it as a comprehensive real estate developer and service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus is on high-quality, end-user driven property development with an emphasis on green, healthy, and smart homes. It pursues product upgrades such as the 'The Top Tower' and 'Four Excellences' series to meet evolving market demands. CIFI is also advancing digital innovation and operational efficiency, aiming to transition towards an asset-light business model to enhance sustainability and resilience amid industry adjustments.
categories.revenue_model: CIFI generates revenue mainly through the sale of developed properties, leasing of investment properties, and provision of property management services. Revenue streams include contracted sales of residential and commercial properties, rental income from investment properties, and fees from property management and value-added services. The Group also earns project management fees and other related service incomes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CIFI is positioned as a leading real estate enterprise in China, ranked 31st nationally by contracted sales in 2024. It competes with other major Chinese property developers focusing on first- and second-tier cities. The Group emphasizes delivery capabilities, product quality, and sustainable development to differentiate itself in a highly competitive market undergoing adjustment and recovery.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, CIFI reported contracted sales of RMB33.68 billion and recognized revenue of approximately RMB47.79 billion, with a net loss attributable to equity owners of RMB7.08 billion. The Group's land bank totaled approximately 29 million sq.m. GFA, with 120 projects under development or held for future development. Despite recent losses, the Group is actively managing debt and restructuring offshore liabilities, aiming for sustainable capital structure and long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CIFI emphasizes building high-quality, end-user focused properties with green, smart, and healthy living environments. Its value proposition includes product innovation through specialized series like 'The Top Tower' and 'Four Excellences,' integration of green building and digital technologies, and strong delivery and operational capabilities. The Group aims to create sustainable value returns by focusing on core urban clusters and enhancing operational efficiency.
